body:
Proves the matching lower obstruction for the endpoint high-degree Boolean noise norm. For fixed0<rho<1, Q=P_sqrt(rho), p=1+1/rho, the norm ||Q H_m||_(2->p) tends tozero exactly when m/sqrt(L) tends toinfinity, using source324 for sufficiency.

A normalized product witness has exactly binomial Fourier energy. Its fourth-order endpoint norm deficit and a Chebyshev leakage bound yield liminf>=exp[-(1-rho^2)C^2/(12rho)] when m/sqrt(L)->C<infinity; in particular the norm tends toone below the square-root scale. The lower profile is not asserted exact.

The witness after high-degree projection is signed. This does not construct a weighting density or prove necessity of the marginal-rigidity condition. No formal/numerical verification, external-priority, independence or physical claim. Ordinary hypercontractivity is attributed prior input; source324 is exact7da3f567d2329a8225d03052c08c554387020fcb, now merged via PR271.

One source file, complete analytical proof and12fixed adverse checks. Requires exact-SHA/body terminal source audit and repository checks. Frozen322B remains unchanged; no separate small-corollary paper proposed.
